desc:
Dummy Defense is a tower defense game where you fight for survival against endless enemies.
The world has been invaded by the Noobs and Guests from beyond the stars, throwing the Dummies into chaos and leaving the planet under their control.
You are the Commander the leader, strategist, and last hope of the Dummies. Build your defenses and lead your army to victory.

Noob Experiment Towers by Flippidee
Noob Experiment Wars Skins by WT#Whathappend

Console:
  R2 = Place tower or selected tower
  R1 = Upgrade tower
  L2 = Sell tower or remove tower
  L1 = change target
